## About
These images contain service instances for Seller and Buyer participants in a private ad auction to participate. More details about signing up and deploying these can be found in our [developer guidance](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2289906).

## Featured Tags
docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/ad-selection/azure/seller-frontend-service:prod-3.11.0.0
docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/ad-selection/azure/auction-service:prod-3.11.0.0
docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/ad-selection/azure/buyer-frontend-service:prod-3.11.0.0
docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/ad-selection/azure/bidding-service:prod-3.11.0.0
docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/ad-selection/azure/k-anonymity-service:prod-3.11.0.0

## Support
For more information about these images and the Ad Selection API, refer to our [developer guidance](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2289906).
For support or general questions, please post in our [public repository](https://github.com/WICG/privacy-preserving-ads/issues).
